pages.title: The snow's own
text: The Snow Fields keep a seal on the drifts, a caribou, and a jellyfish that floats on the cold air, and an ice scorpion that crawls out of the snow at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), and though none has a gift of its own, a bonded one can still take a voice at a totem and strengthen your magic (see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning)).

pages.title: Driftpelt
text: A snow seal, heavy and thick-furred, that hauls itself over the drifts on its flippers in herds of two to four. **26 health** and **5 armour**, and very slow.
It drops **1 to 3 Drift Pelts**, more with Looting.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 2 March Leather. Breed with **Frostberries**.

pages.title: Frost Strider
text: A heavy caribou with a long white mane, quick under great swept antlers, in herds of two to four. **22 health** and **1 armour**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Raw Game, up to 2 March Leather and up to 1 Bone. Breed with **Frostberries**.

pages.title: Snowveil
text: A pale moon jellyfish of the air, a low white-blue dome with four violet rings in it and four frilled arms trailing under it, that drifts over the snow in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Snowballs and up to 1 String. Breed with **Frostberries**.

pages.title: Rime Crawler
text: An ice scorpion, its tail arched over its back, that rises on the open snow at night, one or two at a time. It has **23 health** and **3 armour**, and its sting does **4** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Rime Mandibles**, a Venom reagent. Rime Mandibles call the Cairn Wight at the Cairn Ring, and the Wight calls Rime Crawlers of its own: see [guardians](guardians).
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Snowballs and up to 1 Spider Eye.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
